frames.title: UNKNOWN SIGNAL

Can you still hear me?

Good... the connection between our worlds
is still alive.

Please, do not close this window.

frames.title: THE MAGIC STONES
frames.text:
These are the Magic Stones.

For thousands of years, their light protected
our cities, our forests and every living soul.

frames.title: THE INVADERS
frames.text:
Then... they arrived.

They crossed the dimensional barrier
and came for the power inside the Stones.

frames.title: THE FALL
frames.text:
We tried to stop them.

But one by one, the Stones disappeared...
and our world began to die.

frames.title: THE GUARDIANS
frames.text:
We fought.

We lost.

Every Guardian has fallen.

frames.title: UNKNOWN SIGNAL
frames.text:
There is no Knight left
who can protect this world.

Except...

You.

frames.text:

frames.title: THE LAST SIGNAL
frames.text:
I searched across every dimension...

Will you become our last Knight?

Please, enter the portal
before the final light is gone.
